title: Windows: system-tray icon, single-instance and NoDelay sockets
highlights: Windows: Entanglo now sits in the system tray (notification area) while running in the background. Left-click brings the window back, right-click opens a Show / Quit menu — no more relaunching the .exe to get to the UI after closing.

Windows: single-instance lock — launching the .exe (or the installer's 'Launch' checkbox) while Entanglo is already running just restores the existing window via AppInstance redirection, instead of starting a second process that fails to bind the listen port.

Windows: matching TCP_NODELAY pass — the .NET TcpClient is now set to NoDelay = true on accept and dial, so heartbeats, clipboard frames and any future controller traffic flowing Windows → Mac round-trip with single-RTT latency, matching the Mac 0.1.45 fix.
